crossRefs.note: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.
translations.bsb: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
translations.kjv: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
translations.asv: And they went up to the city; and as they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.
